description: fused_moe_mxfp4 shapes of the AgentX agentic serving corpus replayed on amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4 (TP 4); each performance case is weighted by how often its shapes run (calls per second of the steady state) and the task scores the ratio of total times. The task's earlier shapes and the boundary shapes are correctness-only.

weight_provenance.weight_unit: calls per second of the steady state, TP rank 0
weight_provenance.description: device time of TP rank 0: decode kernels from the eager leg's profiler windows, prefill kernels from every leg's windows, each phase scaled to the graph leg's logged steady-state step count; image lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.23-rocm720-mi35x-20261109; matcher fused_moe; decode shapes padded to captured CUDA-graph batch sizes.
